items.title: ‘That’s why we work in finance – so one day we can afford air-con’: Britain’s unequal heatwave

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Ghana parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
items.description: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.

items.title: What Hungary must do to receive EU funds frozen under Orban
items.description: Prime Minister Peter Magyar and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced a deal that could free up over €16 billion in EU funds for Hungary. Now, Magyar's new government needs to deliver.

items.title: Russia recalls Armenia ambassador over EU ties
items.description: The recall comes a day after Putin warned Armenia against seeking EU membership and alluded to the "Ukrainian scenario." Armenia historically has strong ties with Russia but has pivoted toward the West in recent years.

items.title: Ghana approves law criminalizing LGBTQ+ activities, advocacy
items.description: Ghana's Parliament passed one of the most repressive anti-LGBTQ+ laws in Africa. The law imposes prison terms on individuals who "promote" LGBTQ+ activities.

items.title: EU unblocks €16 billion in Hungary assistance as Magyar promises reforms
items.description: Reforms under new Prime Minister Peter Magyar will enable the EU to free up billions in frozen assistance for Budapest. The EU's Ursula von der Leyen announced the news as Magyar visited Brussels.
